This version: 5-layer trace (raw provider → independent calc → normalize_symbol() → Neon snapshot → API value) for 14 representative symbols × 40+ metrics. eps_growth_proof.impact: Every row where EPS is positive-and-growing YoY but declined QoQ (seasonal) shows a false negative. Every row where EPS is up QoQ but declining YoY shows a false positive. 333 rows affected.

net_debt_ebitda_proof.finding: FMP netDebtToEBITDATTM uses cashAndCashEquivalents ONLY (not cashAndShortTermInvestments). The Cash field correctly uses cashAndShortTermInvestments. This creates an internal inconsistency.
